title: Collapsed sidebar tooltips
approval: Tom requested tooltips for the collapsed sidebar controls.
implementation: Use the existing app data-tooltip presentation for collapsed workspace and settings links, replacing native title labels.
Keep native links, destinations, aria-labels and active-page states.
Position tooltips outside the scrolling rail using measured layout coordinates and DS spacing. Reposition on focus, pointer entry, navigation changes, collapse, resize and rail scroll.
Include expand navigation, clickable Staff Studio brand, account menu and Studio settings. Suppress the account tooltip while its menu is open.
Expanded links retain visible labels without redundant tooltips.

browser: Actual pointer hover: People, opacity 1, positioned at rail right plus DS 8px spacing.

Keyboard traversal covered all seven workspace destinations, the expand control, account and Studio settings. Labels and focus were observed; immediate transition samples were not treated as settled visibility assertions.
Settled keyboard tooltip visibility confirmed on Videos, Media Library, Your menu, Production defaults and Client billing.
All collapsed Studio settings links and Back to workspace have labels; expanded links restore visible copy and remove their data-tooltip.
Account menu opens with Enter and closes with Escape.
Scrolled settings rail at 1133 x 700: Client billing focus tooltip remains aligned (rail scrollTop 32.22px, tooltip centre 491.68px).
No inspected browser warnings or errors.

verification.roles: Staff workspace and Studio settings browser-verified. Role filtering, Client company/personal settings and shared role branches source-reviewed; Customer and Freelancer browser sessions were not repeated for this label change.
